sources.title: OAI-PMH 2.0
sources.governing_conditions: Identify declares no/transient/persistent deletion support. No means vanished records are undiscoverable by incremental harvesting; transient does not guarantee persistence; persistent retains deletion history. Request ranges are inclusive, dates use declared day/second granularity, and resumption tokens govern partial lists. oai_dc is mandatory, richer formats must be discovered separately.
sources.independent_judgment: The conditional connector design is supported. Snapshot reconciliation/staleness thresholds are proposed local choices, not OAI guarantees. No five-collection endpoint compatibility was demonstrated.

sources.independent_judgment: Supports a realistic hub-mediated comparator. The general grouping of Content/Service Hubs is acceptable for this comparison, but their roles are not identical. Acceptance/geographic suitability is not assumed.
